evidence_limit: User-supplied tail omits initialization and does not separately establish total RAM, selected reserve, warmer state or whole-run process counts.
diagnosis: Configuration clamps selected workers to at least one even when no job fits preferred reserve. The later admission check rejects known low memory. This is resource policy, not a theorem elaboration error.

agreed_design.preferred_reserve: Keep separately; do not overwrite the normal policy.
agreed_design.explicit_reserve: Preserve explicit RH_SYSTEM_RESERVE_MB as minimum floor.
agreed_design.eligibility: No active Lean tasks; warmer absent or confirmed exited; forced fresh valid memory snapshot.
agreed_design.warmer_stop_scope: RAM-only helper; do not call whole-run parallelShutdown or discard tracked ownership.
agreed_design.on_admission: Set workers1 and future warming cap0; no promotion during this invocation.
agreed_design.on_insufficient_or_uncertain_resources: Bounded resource failure; no Lean launch; retain lock policy for live/unknown owned processes.
agreed_design.final_audit: Apply serial admission immediately before required compile/re-audit, after accepted frozen reuse can return.
agreed_design.all_cached_run: Do not fail during configuration solely for insufficient launch memory when no actual Lean launch is required.

pitfalls: Do not set live warm reservation to zero until the owned helper is confirmed exited.
Do not add HELD_BYTES to free memory after unmapping; obtain a fresh OS snapshot.
Do not invoke parallelShutdown midrun: its shutdownComplete/shutdownClean fields could bypass final draining.
Do not turn a failed refresh after known memory pressure into the existing unknown-memory serial permission.
Do not admit a second worker in the same loop after serial degradation.
Free memory already reflects resident live usage; retaining full live-worker/warm estimates is conservative double accounting, intentionally unchanged for this patch.
A worker allowance is an estimate, not a process memory cap; snapshot volatility prevents a guarantee against allocation failure.
Compile-to-audit retains one logical task reservation; cache-only final reuse must not require launch memory.
focused_scenarios_proposed_not_run: warm exit confirmed then fresh snapshot => reevaluate
warm exit unknown/live => no release credit and preserve ownership
cached high memory then fresh low => deny
known pressure then WMI refresh failure => deny fallback
all cache hits => no unnecessary memory error
dirty final audit => serial admission; reusable final audit => no gate

sources.supports: FreePhysicalMemory is currently unused available physical memory in kilobytes.
Memory availability snapshots are volatile; not resource reservations.
